title: How Well Can LLMs Echo Us? Evaluating AI Chatbots’ Role-Play Ability with ECHO
reasoning: The paper specifically includes 'Ethical Dilemmas Questions (ED)' as a sub-category for evaluating the role-play abilities of LLMs. These questions are designed to compel respondents to articulate moral judgments in scenarios characterized by moral ambiguity or conflict, making the evaluation of ethics a core part of the benchmarking framework.
